requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
prompt: Execute GET /reports/active without authentication. Verify that the response contains a list of reports filtered to only those with status 'Approved' or equivalent public-visible states. Ensure no internal notes or sensitive reporter data (like full name if anonymous) are exposed in the payload.
rationale: Validates the core public-facing functionality for unregistered users as per PT28.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
prompt: 1. Login as a 'technical office staff member' role. 2. Ensure a report exists in 'Assigned' state. 3. Execute PATCH /technician/reports/{id}/external with payload setting the external maintainer ID. 4. Verify the response indicates successful assignment and the report status reflects the delegation.
setup_needed: POST /login with technical office staff credentials
POST /reports (to create a report in 'Pending Approval' or 'Assigned' state if not pre-existing)
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present. Note: This endpoint modifies state, so ensure the external assignment is rolled back or verified as completed before cleanup logic applies to the specific test artifact.
rationale: Tests the primary workflow for PT24 regarding external maintainer assignment.

requirement_summary: Unregistered user attempts to view reports with sensitive data exposed.
prompt: Execute GET /reports/active without authentication. Verify that the response does NOT contain internal notes, full names of anonymous reporters, or any data marked as private. Ensure only approved reports are returned.
rationale: Tests the domain rule regarding anonymous user visibility and data privacy (Domain Rule: Anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in public Turin map).

requirement_summary: External maintainer attempts to view internal comments from technical office staff.
prompt: 1. Login as an 'external maintainer'. 2. Ensure a report exists with internal comments added by a 'technical office staff member' (via PT26 setup). 3. Execute GET /reports/{id}/comments. 4. Verify that the response does NOT contain the internal comments added by the technical office staff.
setup_needed: Ensure report exists and has internal comments from a different role (technical office staff)
rationale: Tests the domain rule regarding visibility of internal notes to external maintainers (Domain Rule: Case 1/Case 2).

requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
prompt: Register a new citizen user with a valid name, unique username, and email. Ensure the response includes the verification code or token required for subsequent activation.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the core registration flow required for all citizen interactions.

requirement_summary: Citizen confirms registration with a code to activate account.
prompt: Verify the user account using the valid confirmation code received during registration. Ensure the account status changes to 'active' and JWT is issued upon success.
setup_needed: Execute POST /register to obtain a user ID and verification code.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the critical account activation step before any report submission can occur.

requirement_summary: Citizen provides details for their report so that the problem is classified correctly.
prompt: Submit a new report with valid title, description, category, and location. Ensure the report is created in 'Pending Approval' state as per domain rules.
setup_needed: Execute POST /register to create a user.
Execute POST /users/{id}/verify/check with valid code to activate the user.
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; if report exists, delete it using an admin endpoint or verify system handles cleanup automatically.
rationale: Validates the core reporting functionality and initial state management.

requirement_summary: System administrator sets up municipality users.
prompt: Register a new municipality user via the admin endpoint. Ensure the user is created with appropriate default roles or pending role assignment.
setup_needed: Execute POST /login as a system administrator to obtain an admin JWT.
cleanup_strategy: DELETE the created user via an admin endpoint.
rationale: Validates the administrative capability to onboard new staff members.

requirement_summary: System administrator assigns roles to municipality users.
prompt: Assign a specific role (e.g., 'technical office staff') to an existing municipality user. Verify the role assignment is successful and reflected in the user's profile.
setup_needed: Execute POST /admin/register to create a test user.
Execute POST /login as a system administrator.
cleanup_strategy: DELETE the created user via an admin endpoint.
rationale: Validates the core administrative function of role assignment.

requirement_summary: Municipal public relations officer reviews and approves or rejects reports.
prompt: Execute a stateful workflow test where an officer attempts to approve a report that has already been approved. Verify the system handles this gracefully (e.g., idempotency or error indicating state change is not possible).
setup_needed: POST /login with credentials for a user having role 'municipal public relations officer' to obtain JWT.
Ensure a report exists in 'Pending Approval' state.
Execute the happy path approval test (from item 1) on this same report ID to transition it to 'Assigned'.
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was modified incorrectly; ensure subsequent tests use fresh data or verify the specific report ID used.
rationale: Tests the state transition logic to ensure idempotency or proper error handling when re-applying an action.
